messages:
marta: Quick sync — product wants a small "export preview" flow for the "who changed routing" audit download. Goal: let users inspect a sampled diff preview in-console and toggle per-field redaction before starting a full export. :eyes:

jason: Sounds reasonable. Backend thought: we can return a sampled ndjson bundle for the preview and keep a separate async job for full exports. Preflight should return estimated size, quota cost, and a preview token.

priya: Sampling is fine but we need to be explicit about how we pick samples for privileged changes (don't bias away from sensitive events). Also retention/PII flags must travel with each NDJSON row.

marta: yes — UX will need a slide-over showing ~20 sample rows, each with a redaction toggle. If a user toggles redaction we record intent and show estimated cost delta.

jason: Implementation sketch: POST /v1/exports/preflight {query, sample_size} -> {preview_token, sample_ndjson, estimated_bytes, quota_cost}. Then POST /v1/exports/commit {preview_token, redaction_policy} -> returns job_id. We can make preview token short-lived. Example preflight curl:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports/preflight \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  -d '{"query":"policy:route AND actor:alice", "sample_size":20}'
```

marta: love that. UX question: should the console allow inline editing of redaction (eg replace with pseudonym) or only toggle remove/keep?

camille: support perspective — simpler is better for first rollout: toggle keep/remove + a single reason select. Trying to support inline edits will require more legal signoff.

dan: Security notes — presigned download links for the full export must be short TTL (default 1h), require audit log of access and link creation. Also, export job manifests should be signed with our KMS key and include a hash of the bundle so tenant can't tamper with provenance. :lock:

jason: agree. For signed manifest we can include: {job_id, created_at, signer_key_id, bundle_hash, export_query, redaction_policy}. We will sign the manifest and store signature alongside job metadata.

priya: Also add an export-preview flag in telemetry so we can track how often previews are used vs full exports. Helps with quota adjustments.

marta: UX: show a quota pre-check step with a clear banner: "This export will consume ~X export credits and may include sensitive fields. Toggle redaction to reduce credits." :warning:

jason: NDJSON sample we'll return for preview (sanitized example):

```ndjson
{"event":"policy.update","actor":"alice@acme.co","time":"2026-09-01T12:34:56Z","diff":"-ruleA\\n+ruleB","redacted_fields":["ip"]}
{"event":"policy.update","actor":"bob@acme.co","time":"2026-09-01T12:35:10Z","diff":"-routeX\\n+routeY","redacted_fields":[]}
```

dan: Note: the preview sample should mark which fields are eligible for redaction and why (PII, credential, ip). Keep that metadata in the sample rows.

marta: Timeline: can we prototype preflight + preview + commit API + console slide-over by end of sprint? If not full signed-manifest, at least the TTL presigned link and telemetry.

jason: I'll scope it. Plan: small API surface + in-console slide-over mocked from sample. If that looks good we'll wire manifest signing in next sprint.

export-bot: deploy/exports-api-preview v0.1 started by jason (CI: #build-4278)

camille: one more ask — add an inline "contact support" CTA in the preview modal for privileged exports so we can fast-track legal requests.

marta: yes — add that. Ok team, i'll make a tiny product spec and pin it to the thread. Thanks! :thumbsup:
